title: Wayland: Crash when sending SIGINT (Ctrl+C) to editor while game is running
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7.2.stable
- Reproducible in 4.8-dev (6a0f6f32cfb2ce4cc5bad6641d0afda413b62a9d)

### System information

Fedora Linux 44 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor (1920x1080 @ 165.00 Hz) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (radeonsi, phoenix, ACO, DRM 3.64, 7.1.13-200.fc44.x86_64) - AMD Ryzen 7 8845HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 60.60 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When running Godot from a terminal, and while the edited game is running (embedded or floating), sending SIGINT to the editor (e.g. via Ctrl+C in the terminal) crashes the Wayland thread.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create new project, with a simple main scene
- Run it
- Send SIGINT to the editor process (e.g. with Ctrl+C if you ran Godot from a terminal)-

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Any hello world project with the editor running on Wayland.
